Catatan: Dead (diam ≥365hr · 965 barang) metrik berbeda dari Obsolete (umur >36 bln · 528) — irisannya = Critical 456.Obsolete (경과 >36개월 · 528 품목 · Rp 1.45B)는 Non-moving 목록과 동일합니다. 상세 분석(Write-off 466 vs Hold 62 · 위치 · PIC remark · Excel)은 중복을 피해 Adjustment 탭 하단에 통합했습니다.
참고: Dead(비가동 ≥365일 · 965 품목)는 Obsolete(경과 >36개월 · 528)와 다른 지표입니다 — 교집합 = Critical 456. Obsolete (age >36 mo · 528 items · Rp 1.45B) is the same list as Non-moving. To avoid duplication, the detailed analysis (Write-off 466 vs Hold 62 · location · PIC remark · Excel) lives in the Adjustment tab.
Note: Dead (idle ≥365d · 965 items) is a different metric from Obsolete (age >36 mo · 528) — their overlap = Critical 456.
